name: Beetroot Cutlet
steps: Grate the beetroot, squeeze out excess juice and cook it in a dry pan until its raw smell fades; cool.
Mash the potatoes and mix with beetroot, minced chili, coriander, ginger, chaat masala, salt and half the crumbs.
Shape equal oval cutlets with firm hands; coat each in the remaining crumbs and chill until set.
Heat a thin film of oil in a skillet and shallow-fry cutlets over medium heat until one side is golden; turn once carefully.
Brown the second side, drain briefly and serve hot with coriander chutney while the crust is crisp.
tips: Drying the beetroot first prevents the patties from turning soft and leaking color into the oil.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
